data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Bluma is derived from the word ‘blome’, meaning ‘bloom’ or ‘flower’. This name symbolizes growth, beauty, and renewal. The name Bluma carries the meaning “Bloom, flower” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bluma usually hope their child will grow to embody bloom, flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bluma may not have a direct cultural association with Christianity, but its meaning resonates with biblical principles such as growth, renewal, and beauty. It reminds us of the significance of new life and resurrection, which are themes central to the Christian faith.
